deals.date_text: Agreement 11 July 2026; NFL approval 26 August 2026; closed 3 September 2026
deals.evidence: for a league-record price of $9.612 billion
deals.headline: Khosla family buys the Seattle Seahawks from the Paul G. Allen estate for a reported record $9.612bn
deals.summary: The Estate of Paul G. Allen signed a formal sale agreement with a group led by the Khosla family on 11 July 2026 (terms not disclosed by the club). NFL owners approved unanimously on 26 August and the sale closed on 3 September 2026. NFL.com, citing ESPN, reports a league-record price of $9.612 billion.

deals.evidence: today announced a minority investment in the Seattle Seahawks in support of the Khosla family’s purchase of the team
deals.headline: Sixth Street takes a minority stake in the Seahawks alongside the Khosla purchase
deals.summary: Sixth Street announced a minority investment in the Seattle Seahawks in support of the Khosla family's purchase, approved by the NFL at the 26 August league meeting. Size not disclosed.

deals.evidence: Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) and Dynasty Equity today announced the closing of their minority investments in the Seattle Seahawks
deals.headline: Carlyle and Dynasty Equity close minority investments in the Seahawks
deals.summary: Carlyle and Dynasty Equity closed minority investments in the Seattle Seahawks in support of the Khosla family's purchase, approved at the NFL's Special League Meeting on 26 August 2026. Size not disclosed.

name: Seattle Seahawks
notes: Revenue, operating income, player expenses and value are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (list of 9 Sep 2026, via Wayback; the team profile on forbes.com gives operating income $130M against the list's $131M). Forbes' team profile lists Year Purchased '1997, 2026' and Price Paid '$194M, $2.88B'; the $2.88B is not explained on the page and conflicts with the $9.612bn NFL.com/ESPN report and the list article's '$9.6 billion', so it is not used. Paul Allen's 1997 price ($194 million from Ken Behring) is stated by NFL.com. Stakes of the Khoslas, co-owners and the three institutional investors are not stated. Debt/Value 2% per Forbes, no amount. Lumen Field opened 2002 (Forbes). Legal entity of the club not stated (First & Goal LLC is the stadium operating affiliate named in titles). Attendance and social counts not found. Seahawks won Super Bowl LX in February 2026 (PFHOF).

ownership_summary: Controlled since September 2026 by the Khosla family (Vinod Khosla chair, Neeru Khosla controlling owner, Neal Khosla vice chair), who bought the club from the Estate of Paul G. Allen for a reported league-record $9.612 billion; the Allen family had owned it since 1997. Co-owners include Carlyle with Dynasty Equity and Sixth Street (minority investments approved by the NFL on 26 August 2026) and individuals including Penny Pritzker; no stake percentages are stated.
